integrity: Proof is self-contained apart from standard CW-covering and Bass–Serre free-product facts; finite independent integral Smith calculations are reproducibility checks, not an arbitrary-prime proof.
scientific_limitations: Prime moduli at least five, precisely three-term cyclic progressions, facet complexes only; higher homotopy types not determined; independent mathematical audit absent; literature equivalence remains possible.
title: Fundamental groups and torsion of cyclic three-term progression complexes
